# Literature search ledger

Search date: 21 July 2026. Open-web results were checked against publisher,
DOI, institutional repository, INSPIRE, CERN, OSTI, or official problem
records. Subscription-database priority searching should be refreshed before
external submission.

| Query family | Sources screened | Inclusion decision |
|---|---|---|
| heat-kernel lattice gauge action | CERN/INSPIRE and Nuclear Physics B record for Menotti--Onofri, DOI 10.1016/0550-3213(81)90560-5 | included as regulator baseline |
| Villain lattice gauge interaction | Journal of Statistical Physics record for Chevyrev--Garban, DOI 10.1007/s10955-025-03420-1 | included as current regulator relation |
| lattice gauge propagators and RG | Springer/Rutgers record for Balaban 1984, DOI 10.1007/BF01215753 | included |
| small-field effective actions | Rutgers/OSTI record for Balaban 1987, DOI 10.1007/BF01215223 | closest constructive result; included |
| cluster-expanded fluctuation integral | Rutgers/OSTI record for Balaban 1988, DOI 10.1007/BF01239022 | included |
| large-field operation | Rutgers record for Balaban 1989, DOI 10.1007/BF01238433 | included to mark missing complement control |
| maximal-tree lattice gauge | Annals of Physics record and arXiv hep-lat/0001028, DOI 10.1006/aphy.2000.6070 | included as gauge-coordinate baseline |
| log-concave marginal covariance | Journal of Functional Analysis record for Brascamp--Lieb, DOI 10.1016/0022-1236(76)90004-5 | included as proof input |
| log-Sobolev to transport | Journal of Functional Analysis record for Otto--Villani, DOI 10.1006/jfan.1999.3557 | included as proof input |
| constructive gauge theory | Annals of Physics/OSTI record for Brydges--Fröhlich--Seiler, DOI 10.1016/0003-4916(79)90098-8 | included for scope comparison |
| computer-assisted QFT / exact finite lattice certificate | open primary-source searches for interval RG, exact gauge block, certified Hodge block | no identical theorem located; no priority claim inferred |
| Yang--Mills existence and gap | Clay Mathematics Institute official problem description | included only to calibrate scope |

Unresolved priority question: an exhaustive MathSciNet, zbMATH, and INSPIRE
forward-citation search may locate unpublished or differently framed finite
block computations. Recommended language remains “integrated explicit
certificate,” never “first” or “unprecedented.”
